newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway T-bill expansion gets 4.15 pct high yield.
newsitem.headline: Norway T-bill expansion gets 4.15 pct high yield.

text.p: Norway's central bank said on Thursday that a 12 billion crown expansion of Treasury bill SS42 produced a highest yield of 4.15 percent.
The lowest yield was 4.06 percent and the weighted average rate was 4.13 percent. Bids for the highest accepted rate had a 77.7 percent allotment.
The bill was issued on March 14 with a nominal interest rate of 4.70 percent. It matures on March 19, 1997.
The auction was announced on Monday. The bank does not provide figures for the total amount of money issued in the bill.
